name: print-social-background-teal-spotlight-beams-dark
title: Teal spotlight beam stage background
whatItIs: A dark auditorium background photo showing teal-colored spotlight beams shining down through haze against a near-black backdrop.
whatItMeans: A moody lit-beam background provides instant atmosphere and depth for event marketing without needing any subject in frame, leaving space for text or product overlays.
techniques: photograph light beams through haze/fog to add volumetric depth to a dark background
keep the entire composition in a narrow dark-to-teal tonal range for mood
leave the lower two-thirds emptier of detail to reserve space for overlaid text

vocabulary.definition: visible light rays scattered through a medium like fog or dust, adding a sense of depth and atmosphere
